result:
`sendPayout` now logs an error through `logger.error` when the transfer fails. I haven't run it or compiled it.

The log entry is `"payout transfer failed"` and includes:
- `expertId`
- `amountCents`, which is `payout.amount`
- `error`, the transfer error string

It logs the expert `id` only, not their email, phone or the whole `expert` object. A Security rule bars logging expert contact details, so support will need to look the expert up in the admin tool to contact them.

The function still returns `false` on failure, so callers behave as before. I also added the `logger` import from `../logger`.
